Skim across the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Thailand aboard a high-speed catamaran to Coral Island (Koh Larn), plunging into crystalline coral bays or lounging beneath swaying palms on powdery white sands. By night, witness the theatrical magnificence of the world-acclaimed Alcazar Cabaret with its dazzling pyrotechnics, choreography, and imperial costumes. Journey next into the pulsating heart of Bangkok, paying homage before the solid 5.5-ton Golden Buddha at Wat Traimit and exploring the Italian marble colonnades of Wat Benchamabophit. Encounter free-roaming lions and dolphins at Safari World & Marine Park, before dining on an illuminated Chao Phraya River dinner cruise as Wat Arun glows along the riverbanks.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok & Transfer to Pattaya Beach with Alcazar Show
itinerary.description: Touch down at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) where our local representative warmly welcomes you with chilled mineral water. Board your comfortable air-conditioned coach for a scenic 125-kilometer motorway drive directly to the coastal resort city of Pattaya. Check into your stylish beachside resort and take time to refresh. In the evening at 6:00 PM, transfer to the grand Alcazar Theatre. Enjoy VIP seating for the world-renowned 70-minute Alcazar Cabaret show, featuring spellbinding choreography, dazzling crystal costumes, and state-of-the-art stage lighting. Spend your night strolling the lively beachfront promenade.

itinerary.title: Speedboat Tour to Coral Island (Koh Larn) & Indian Buffet Lunch
itinerary.description: After an energizing breakfast, transfer to Bali Hai Pier and board a modern twin-engine speedboat across the sparkling Gulf of Thailand to Coral Island (Koh Larn). Step onto the soft white sands of Ta Waen Beach. Spend your morning swimming in crystal-clear waters or opting for exciting marine activities like parasailing from the floating platform and underwater sea walking. At midday, enjoy a warm Indian and international buffet lunch served at an island restaurant. Return by speedboat to Pattaya by 2:30 PM, leaving your afternoon free to unwind at the resort pool.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok: Wat Traimit & Wat Benchamabophit Temples
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast, check out of your Pattaya resort, and begin your comfortable drive back to the capital city of Bangkok. Upon entering the city, embark directly on an enriching guided temple tour. First, visit Wat Traimit in Chinatown to marvel at the world's largest solid gold seated Buddha, weighing an astonishing 5.5 tons. Continue to the exquisite Wat Benchamabophit, constructed from white Carrara Italian marble with traditional orange-tiled Thai gables. By afternoon, check into your modern downtown Bangkok hotel and explore vibrant evening street-food alleys in Sukhumvit.

itinerary.title: Safari World Open Zoo & Marine Park with Grand Buffet Lunch
itinerary.description: Savor an early breakfast before departing on an exciting full-day excursion to Safari World and Marine Park, Asia's premier wildlife park. First drive through the open Safari Park, viewing African giraffes, zebras, rhinoceros, and roaring lions from the safe comfort of your air-conditioned coach. Next, step into the lush Marine Park to witness spectacular choreographed performances including the world-famous Dolphin Show, Sea Lion Show, and Hollywood Cowboy Stunt Show. Relish an extensive international and Indian buffet lunch inside the park before returning to the city by 4:30 PM.

itinerary.title: IconSiam Riverfront Mall & Chao Phraya Dinner Cruise
itinerary.description: Spend your morning browsing Bangkok's premier riverside lifestyle destination, IconSiam, featuring an indoor floating market showcasing crafts and delicacies from Thailand's 77 provinces. In the evening at 7:00 PM, board a luxurious multi-deck cruise ship along the Chao Phraya River. As the vessel sails past floodlit landmarks including the Grand Palace and the porcelain spire of Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn), indulge in an extravagant international buffet featuring fresh seafood, Thai curries, and sushi, serenaded by a live jazz band under the starlit sky.

itinerary.title: Pratunam Shopping & Suvarnabhumi Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy your final morning buffet breakfast in Bangkok. Take advantage of late morning hours for souvenir and clothing shopping at the world-famous wholesale fashion malls of Pratunam and Platinum Fashion Mall, or browse high-tech electronics at MBK Center. Return to the hotel to pack your treasures and check out by noon. Your private driver will provide a smooth, punctual transfer to Bangkok Suvarnabhumi International Airport (BKK) in time for your return flight home, taking back joyful memories of the Land of Smiles.

faqs.q: Do Indian passport holders need a visa to visit Thailand?
faqs.a: Under current Thai immigration regulations, Indian passport holders enjoy Visa-Free entry / Visa Exemption for tourism purposes for stays up to 30 or 60 days. You only need a passport with 6 months validity, confirmed return flight tickets, and hotel accommodation proof.

faqs.q: Is the Coral Island speedboat ride suitable for seniors and young children?
faqs.a: Speedboats can be bumpy depending on ocean waves. Seniors with chronic back ailments and infants are advised to sit toward the rear of the speedboat where movement is gentler, or opt for a relaxing mainland beach day instead.

faqs.q: Are vegetarian and Indian food options available on the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, absolutely. Thailand is extremely accommodating to Indian palates. The Coral Island lunch and the Safari World buffet both offer dedicated Indian vegetarian and non-vegetarian buffet spreads. In Bangkok and Pattaya, hundreds of authentic Indian restaurants operate.

faqs.q: What is the dress code for the Alcazar Cabaret Show?
faqs.a: Smart casual attire is recommended for the Alcazar Show. While there is no rigid black-tie dress code, avoid beach swimwear or excessively casual clothing inside the air-conditioned theatre.

faqs.q: Can I feed the giraffes at Safari World?
faqs.a: Yes. Safari World features a world-famous open-air elevated wooden feeding deck where guests can purchase small buckets of bananas (approx. 100 THB) and hand-feed hundreds of friendly giraffes up close, providing incredible photography opportunities.

faqs.q: How much cash should I carry to Thailand?
faqs.a: We recommend carrying approximately 10,000 to 15,000 Thai Baht (or equivalent USD) per couple in cash for shopping, street food, tuk-tuks, and tipping. Most major malls and hotels accept international Visa and Mastercard.

faqs.q: Is tap water drinkable in Thailand?
faqs.a: Tap water is not recommended for direct drinking in Thailand. Always drink sealed bottled water, which is provided complimentary daily in your hotel rooms and on our tour coaches.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Shimla & Drive to Narkanda
itinerary.description: Meet your group and start the beautiful drive through pine forests.

itinerary.title: Narkanda to Chitkul/Sangla
itinerary.description: Drive to the last Indian village before the Tibet border, breathing in the fresh mountain air.

itinerary.title: Chitkul to Kalpa
itinerary.description: Witness the majestic Kinnaur Kailash range from the beautiful village of Kalpa.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Kaza
itinerary.description: Cross into the barren landscapes of Spiti, visiting the Nako Lake and Tabo Monastery en route.

itinerary.title: Kaza Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Key Monastery, the high-altitude villages of Kibber, Hikkim (highest post office), and Komic.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal
itinerary.description: Drive over the mighty Kunzum Pass and camp near the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake.

itinerary.title: Chandratal to Manali
itinerary.description: Off-roading experience over the Rohtang Pass down into the lush Kullu Valley.

itinerary.title: Departure from Manali
itinerary.description: Trip ends with a lifetime of memories.

trips.title: Leh Ladakh Expedition
trips.description: Experience the ultimate road trip to the Land of High Passes. Marvel at the changing colors of Pangong Tso, ride camels in Nubra Valley, and conquer Khardung La.
highlights: Khardung La Pass
Pangong Tso Lake
Double-Humped Camel Ride
Shanti Stupa

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh
itinerary.description: Acclimatize to the high altitude. Visit Shanti Stupa and Leh Palace in the evening.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley
itinerary.description: Drive over Khardung La, one of the highest motorable roads. Enjoy the sand dunes in Hunder.

itinerary.title: Turtuk Excursion
itinerary.description: Day trip to the breathtaking Turtuk village near the LoC, experiencing Balti culture.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso
itinerary.description: Drive alongside the Shyok river to reach the magnificent blue waters of Pangong Lake.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh
itinerary.description: Wake up to a beautiful sunrise at the lake, then drive back to Leh via Chang La.

itinerary.title: Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Explore Magnetic Hill, Pathar Sahib Gurudwara, and the Hall of Fame.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Fly out of Leh with incredible Himalayan memories.

trips.title: Kashmir Winter Wonderland
trips.description: Step into paradise on earth. Sail on the tranquil Dal Lake in a Shikara, experience the thrill of the Gulmarg Gondola, and wander through the scenic valleys of Pahalgam.
highlights: Houseboat Stay
Gulmarg Gondola Ride
Betaab Valley
Dal Lake Shikara Ride

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Check into a traditional houseboat. Evening Shikara ride on the Dal Lake.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg
itinerary.description: Travel to the meadow of flowers. Take the famous Gondola cable car ride to Apharwat peak.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Drive through saffron fields and apple orchards to reach the Valley of Shepherds.

itinerary.title: Explore Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Visit the stunning Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, and Chandanwari.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Return to Srinagar. Visit the beautiful Mughal Gardens and local markets.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the heavenly valley of Kashmir.

trips.title: Backpacking Meghalaya
trips.description: Dive into the abode of clouds. Trek to the magical living root bridges, explore the deepest caves, and boat on the crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River.
highlights: Double Decker Root Bridge
Dawki River Boating
Mawsmai Caves
Nohkalikai Falls

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Guwahati to Shillong
itinerary.description: Arrive in Guwahati and drive to the Scotland of the East. Visit Umiam Lake en route.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Cherrapunji
itinerary.description: Visit Nohkalikai Falls, Seven Sisters Falls, and explore the Mawsmai limestone caves.

itinerary.title: Nongriat Trek
itinerary.description: Hike down thousands of steps to witness the bio-engineering marvel of the Double Decker Living Root Bridge.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji to Dawki
itinerary.description: Drive to the Bangladesh border. Enjoy boating on the crystal clear waters of the Umngot River.

itinerary.title: Dawki to Shillong via Krang Suri
itinerary.description: Visit the magical blue waters of Krang Suri waterfalls before heading back to Shillong.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drive back to Guwahati for your onward journey.

trips.title: Kerala Backwaters & Hills
trips.description: A perfect blend of serene backwaters, lush tea gardens, and rich wildlife. Witness the majestic Western Ghats and cruise through the tranquil waters of Alleppey.
highlights: Alleppey Houseboat Stay
Munnar Tea Gardens
Periyar Wildlife Safari
Kathakali Show

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi to Munnar
itinerary.description: Drive through winding roads to the beautiful tea hills of Munnar. En route visit Cheeyappara Waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Explore Eravikulam National Park, Mattupetty Dam, and the Tea Museum.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady
itinerary.description: Travel to Periyar. Enjoy an elephant safari and an authentic spice plantation tour.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey
itinerary.description: Board a traditional house-boat. Sail through the palm-fringed backwaters and enjoy Kerala cuisine.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drive back to Kochi for your departure flight.

trips.title: Andaman Tropical Escape
trips.description: Unwind on pristine white-sand beaches and dive into crystal clear waters. Discover the rich marine life of the Andaman Sea and the historical significance of Port Blair.
highlights: Scuba Diving
Radhanagar Beach Sunset
Cellular Jail
Island Hopping

captain.name: Captain Rohan Shah
captain.bio: Expert in high-altitude trekking and local storytelling.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Port Blair
itinerary.description: Visit the historic Cellular Jail and attend the spectacular Light and Sound show.

itinerary.title: Port Blair to Havelock
itinerary.description: Ferry to Havelock Island. Relax at the world-famous Radhanagar Beach.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Excursion
itinerary.description: Enjoy snorkeling or scuba diving to witness vibrant coral reefs and marine life.

itinerary.title: Havelock to Neil Island
itinerary.description: Take a ferry to the serene Neil Island. Watch a beautiful sunset at Laxmanpur Beach.

itinerary.title: Explore Neil Island
itinerary.description: Visit the Natural Bridge formation and the pristine Bharatpur Beach.

itinerary.title: Return to Port Blair
itinerary.description: Ferry back to the capital. Spend the evening shopping for souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Leave with a sun-kissed glow and beautiful memories.
